thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Dedicated GPU pool 'dedicated-eu-3' reserved utilization 98% (reserved=48/49 GPUs). Queue length for reserved tenants: 1.2k reqs. Elevated 5xx from tenant 'OrchidBank'. Auto-scaler attempted scale but hit pool limit. Paging oncall.

sre_jordan: oncall here, seeing the same. tagging @kevin_oncall to take lead.

kevin_oncall: acknowledged. pulling queue metrics now.

kevin_oncall: `curl -s https://internal-api.redwood/metrics/pool/dedicated-eu-3 | jq .` -> queued_requests: 1214, avg_latency_ms: 3120, 5xx_rate: 8.7% (tenant: OrchidBank responsible for ~760 queued).

marta_platform: quick triage — looks like noisy neighbor from OrchidBank jobs with long KV-cache retention + large batch sizes. Also autoscaler hit max_pools=4 per region (config param).

infra_tina: confirmed config: region eu max_pools for dedicated = 4. dedicated-eu-3 is already at that cap (we have 4 pools, one reserved for infra). Cannot spin a new pool without override.

kevin_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) throttle OrchidBank to their reserved qps temporarily, 2) evict best-effort batch jobs in pool, 3) route new OrchidBank requests to hosted fallback (non-dedicated) for degraded mode, 4) open infra override to raise max_pools.

ryan_support: I'll draft a brief customer note once we have scope. Initial impact: OrchidBank sees request timeouts and delayed responses; some jobs failing with 503.

product_ellie: SLA question: OrchidBank has reserved capacity for 40 GPUs and 'burst' of 8. If reserved fully used, what is our committed behavior? We need a clear line to communicate.

sre_jordan: short answer — we should keep reserved tenants available up to reserved count; burst is best-effort. When pool saturated we either evict lower-priority workloads or fallback to hosted for graceful degradation. We'll keep you posted.

kevin_oncall: executing evict command now for non-reserved class jobs:
```
POST /admin/pool/dedicated-eu-3/evict
{ "selector": "job_class:best_effort", "max_evictions": 20 }
```
kevin_oncall: evicted 14 jobs, freed 3 GPUs. queue -> 970. 5xx -> 6.1%

marta_platform: good. next: apply temporary throttle for OrchidBank to 60% of their sustained qps to drain backlog more predictably.

kevin_oncall: applying quota via admin api: `PATCH /tenants/OrchidBank/quota { "qps": 240 }` -> success. queued_requests now 680.

kevin_oncall: routing new OrchidBank non-critical requests to hosted fallback: `route set tenant=OrchidBank fallback=hosted-low` — starting now.

infra_tina: opened emergency change to raise region max_pools to 6. Need approval from infra-ops and infra-owner. Tagging @infra-approvers.

incidents-bot: PAGE sent to infra-approvers at 2065432215.

eng_runtime_leo: oncall runtime here — autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failed due to validation error: `pool_count + 1 > region_max_pools` (expected). Also noticed churn from OrchidBank's long-running sessions preventing GPU reclaim due to KV cache pinned. We'll need a hotfix to allow eviction policy to force-evict stale KV caches.

kevin_oncall: attempting forced reclaim on 2 long-running sessions with job ids: job_9132, job_9141. command: `POST /admin/session/reclaim { "session_ids": ["job_9132","job_9141"], "force": true }` -> reclaimed 2 sessions, freed 2 GPUs. queued_requests -> 420. 5xx -> 2.9%

ryan_support: customer note draft: "We're experiencing high load in a dedicated pool impacting OrchidBank. We've throttled traffic and routed non-critical requests to our hosted fallback; severe timeouts may occur for long-running requests. We're actively increasing capacity and investigating root cause. Will follow up in 1h with status."

product_ellie: good, send once we confirm stabilization. Note any incurred data plane differences that affect latency/cost.

kevin_oncall: stabilization trending: queue 420 -> 210 over 15 mins after throttles + evictions. 5xx down to 1.1%.

infra_tina: emergency change approved by infra-approvers. increasing region max_pools to 6 now.

eng_runtime_leo: autoscaler now allowed to create new pool. starting pool spin-up: `kubectl apply -f pool-dedicated-eu-5.yaml` -> pool provisioning started (expected ~6-8m).

kevin_oncall: provisioning logs: `pool-dedicated-eu-5 ready` at 2065432330. Pool added +10 GPUs. queue drained to 80. 5xx < 0.5%.

sre_jordan: great work. current status: OrchidBank QoS restored to reserved levels, most queued requests processed, fallback routing still active for non-critical paths until we confirm no regressions.

ryan_support: sent customer note at 2065432345.

product_ellie: schedule postmortem and include: autoscaler validation loosen, eviction policy for pinned KV caches, and clear docs on reserved vs burst behavior. Also ensure we have a playbook for customer comms.

kevin_oncall: filing incident ticket: INC-2065432100. Assigned to eng_runtime_leo + marta_platform for root cause and long-term mitigation.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: dedicated-eu-3 pool saturation mitigated, pool+1 provisioned, queue drained. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
